Which pattern-evaluation measure most properly reflects the collaboration proximity for pattern {JL, HG}? Check all that apply.
questions.explanation: With a huge number of null transactions (neither author), only null-invariant measures are reliable; Kulczynski is null-invariant, whereas Lift and χ² are strongly affected by the null count.
questions.hint: Nhiều null (2.7e6) => dùng null-invariant metric như Kulczynski (Lift, χ² bị sai lệch).

questions.question: Suppose one needs to mine frequent patterns at two levels, with min-support of 5% (higher level) and 1% (lower level). If using shared multi-level mining, which min-support threshold should be used to generate candidate patterns for the higher level?
questions.explanation: In shared (uniform) multi-level mining, the lowest min-support (1%) is applied at all levels so that low-level frequent patterns are not missed; hence candidates at the higher level use 1%.
questions.hint: Shared multi-level: dùng chung min-support thấp nhất (1%) cho mọi cấp.

questions.question: Consider the support-based and null-invariant definitions for negative patterns. Let ε = 0.01. In a database of 10^9 total transactions, 10^6 contain item A, 10^4 contain item B, and 10^2 contain both A and B. Which of the following is true? (Support-based negative: P(A,B) << P(A)*P(B). Null-invariant negative: (P(A|B)+P(B|A))/2 < ε.)
options: {A, B} is a negative pattern only by the null-invariant definition.
{A, B} is a negative pattern by the null-invariant definition because (P(B|A)+P(A|B))/2 = (10^-4 + 10^-2)/2 = 0.00505 < 0.01.
{A, B} is not a negative pattern by either definition.
{A, B} is a negative pattern by both definitions.
{A, B} is a negative pattern only by the support-based definition.
questions.explanation: Support-based: P(A,B)=10^-7 vs P(A)P(B)=10^-8, so P(A,B) is 10x larger, NOT negative. Null-invariant: (P(A|B)+P(B|A))/2 = (10^-2+10^-4)/2 ≈ 0.00505 < 0.01, so negative. Hence negative only by null-invariant.
questions.hint: Support-based: so P(A,B) với P(A)P(B). Null-invariant: trung bình 2 confidence. Ở đây chỉ null-invariant kết luận negative.
questions.review: Đề có 2 phương án cùng đúng (lỗi ra đề); đáp án lưu là phương án đầy đủ nhất.

questions.question: Given transactions T1 {a,b,c,d,e}, T2 {a,b,d,e}, T3 {a,b,c,d,e,f}, T4 {a,b,c,d,f}, and the pattern distance measure distance = 1 - |intersection of supporting transactions| / |union of supporting transactions|, what is the distance between pattern "abcd" and pattern "abde"?
questions.explanation: abcd is supported by {T1,T3,T4}; abde by {T1,T2,T3}. Intersection = {T1,T3} (2), union = {T1,T2,T3,T4} (4); distance = 1 - 2/4 = 0.5.
questions.hint: Distance = 1 - |giao|/|hợp| của tập giao dịch chứa mỗi pattern (Jaccard distance).

questions.question: Given the sequence database S1 <a(abc)(ac)d(cf)>, S2 <(ad)c(bc)(ae)>, S3 <(ef)(ab)(df)cb>, S4 <eg(af)cbc>, which of the following is NOT a subsequence of any sequence in the database?
questions.explanation: <aa(bc)> requires an 'a', then another 'a', then 'b' and 'c' together in a later element; no sequence has an itemset with b and c together occurring after two separate a's, so it is not a subsequence.
questions.hint: Kiểm tra thứ tự: <aa(bc)> cần a, a, rồi (bc) chung một itemset phía sau — không sequence nào có.

questions.question: Given a sequence database, suppose <ab>, <ac>, and <bc> are the only length-two frequent sequential patterns. Which of the following might also be a frequent sequential pattern?
questions.explanation: By the Apriori property every length-2 subsequence of a frequent length-3 pattern must itself be frequent. <abc> has subsequences <ab>, <ac>, <bc>, all frequent; the others contain infrequent subsequences such as <ad>, <db> or <cb>.
questions.hint: Apriori property cho sequence: một length-3 pattern chỉ có thể frequent nếu MỌI subsequence length-2 của nó đều frequent. Với candidate <abc>, các subsequence là <ab>,<ac>,<bc> - tất cả đều nằm trong tập frequent. Quy tắc: liệt kê mọi subsequence length-2 (giữ đúng thứ tự) rồi kiểm tra; chỉ một cái không frequent là loại. Bẫy: <cba> chứa <cb>, <adb> chứa <ad>/<db> - đều không frequent nên bị loại.
questions.trick: Thấy length-2 frequent chỉ <ab>,<ac>,<bc> → chọn <abc> (mọi subsequence dài 2 đều frequent).

questions.question: Given the sequence database S10 <a(abc)(ac)d(cf)>, S20 <(ad)c(bc)(ae)>, S30 <(ef)(ab)(df)cb>, S40 <eg(af)cbc>, using the vertical data format, which sequence (by SID) belongs to the <g>-projected database?
questions.explanation: Only sequence S40 <eg(af)cbc> contains the item g, so only SID 40 belongs to the <g>-projected database.
questions.hint: Chỉ sequence nào chứa 'g' mới vào <g>-projected DB; chỉ SID 40 có g.

questions.question: Given a support threshold of 5% and a confidence threshold of 60%, which of the following spatial association rules is valid? (each rule shown with [support, confidence])
options: is_a(x, large_town) ^ intersect(x, highway) -> adjacent_to(x, forest) [3%, 85%]
is_a(x, large_town) ^ intersect(x, highway) -> adjacent_to(x, water) [7%, 85%]
is_a(x, city) ^ intersect(x, highway) -> population(x, large) [4%, 85%]
is_a(x, large_town) ^ adjacent_to(x, water) -> intersect(x, highway) [8%, 50%]
questions.explanation: A valid rule needs support >= 5% AND confidence >= 60%. Only [7%, 85%] satisfies both; the others fail either support (3%, 4%) or confidence (50%).
questions.hint: Phải đạt CẢ hai: support ≥ 5% và confidence ≥ 60%. Chỉ [7%, 85%] thỏa.

questions.question: Which of the following moving-cluster patterns does NOT require the objects to move together for consecutive timestamps?
questions.explanation: A swarm only requires the objects to be in the same cluster for a number of possibly non-consecutive timestamps, whereas flock and convoy both demand consecutive timestamps.
questions.hint: Ba mẫu moving-cluster khác nhau ở ràng buộc thời gian. Flock và Convoy đòi các object ở cùng cluster tại các timestamp LIÊN TIẾP (consecutive). Swarm lỏng nhất: chỉ cần cùng cluster tại một số timestamp, KHÔNG bắt buộc liên tiếp. Quy tắc: hỏi 'không cần liên tiếp' → chọn Swarm. Bẫy: Flock thêm ràng buộc hình dạng/vùng tròn, Convoy dùng density-based, nhưng cả hai đều cần liên tiếp.
questions.trick: Thấy "NOT require consecutive timestamps" (Flock/Swarm/Convoy) → chọn Swarm (lỏng nhất, timestamp không liên tiếp).

questions.question: For mining frequent movement patterns from a trajectory database, why is it necessary to group similar locations?
options: Because the locations fall in a continuous space, they need to be grouped together to collectively form frequent patterns
Because we want to find large clusters in the frequent movement patterns
Because grouping locations is the only way to remove GPS measurement outliers before mining
questions.explanation: Raw GPS readings lie in a continuous space and almost never repeat exactly, so nearby locations must be grouped into discrete regions before repeated movements can be counted and reach a support threshold.
questions.hint: Toạ độ GPS nằm trong không gian LIÊN TỤC (continuous) nên hai lần đi qua gần như không bao giờ trùng khớp chính xác. Phải gom các location gần nhau thành vùng/region rời rạc thì mới đếm được số lần lặp và đạt support threshold. Quy tắc: lý do gom nhóm = rời rạc hoá không gian liên tục để hình thành frequent pattern. Bẫy: gom nhóm không phải để tìm cluster lớn hay chỉ để lọc outlier.
questions.trick: Thấy "why group similar locations" → chọn "continuous space nên phải gom để cùng tạo frequent pattern".

questions.question: When detecting periodicity from sparse trajectory data, what is the benefit of clustering locations to form reference spots?
options: To overcome data sparsity so that the periodicity becomes clearer
To reduce the data dimension for later analysis
To guarantee that every detected period is exactly 24 hours
questions.explanation: Clustering scattered observations into reference spots aggregates sparse visits into a denser binary time series per spot, which makes the underlying periodic behaviour detectable when the raw data alone is too sparse.
questions.hint: Dữ liệu quỹ đạo thường THƯA (sparse): mỗi reference spot chỉ có ít lần ghi nhận rải rác nên khó thấy chu kỳ. Clustering location thành reference spot gom các quan sát thưa lại thành chuỗi thời gian dày hơn cho mỗi spot, làm periodicity (tính chu kỳ) lộ rõ. Quy tắc: mục đích = khắc phục data sparsity. Bẫy: không phải để giảm chiều dữ liệu, cũng không đảm bảo chu kỳ đúng 24 giờ.
questions.trick: Thấy "periodicity từ sparse data, reference spots" → chọn "overcome data sparsity để periodicity rõ hơn".

questions.question: Which of the following strategies does ToPMine use for mining phrase-level topics?
options: Strategy 1: Simultaneously inferring phrases and topics
Strategy 2: Post topic-modeling phrase construction (e.g., Turbo Topics)
Strategy 3: First phrase mining, then topic modeling
questions.explanation: ToPMine first segments the corpus into frequent phrases (phrase mining), then runs topic modeling over the resulting phrase bags, i.e. Strategy 3.
questions.hint: Có ba chiến lược mining phrasal topic. Strategy 1: suy luận phrase và topic ĐỒNG THỜI (vd PDLDA). Strategy 2: chạy topic model trước rồi ghép phrase sau (vd Turbo Topics). Strategy 3: phrase mining TRƯỚC rồi topic modeling sau - đây chính là ToPMine (nhớ 'To-Phrase-mine' trước). Quy tắc: ToPMine = segment corpus thành phrase rồi mới mô hình topic. Bẫy: đừng nhầm ToPMine với Strategy 1 của PDLDA.
questions.trick: Thấy "ToPMine strategy" → chọn Strategy 3: First phrase mining, then topic modeling.

questions.question: For the task of phrase mining, is ToPMine a supervised or an unsupervised approach?
options: Semi-supervised, requiring a small labeled seed set of phrases
questions.explanation: ToPMine mines phrases purely from corpus statistics (frequency and significance of contiguous segments) with no labeled training data, so it is unsupervised.
questions.hint: ToPMine mine phrase HOÀN TOÀN từ thống kê corpus (tần suất và độ significant của đoạn liền kề), không dùng dữ liệu gán nhãn nào → UNSUPERVISED. Quy tắc: không có labeled training data thì là unsupervised. Bẫy: SegPhrase mới cần một ít training data (weakly/distantly supervised); đừng lẫn hai phương pháp này.
questions.trick: Thấy "ToPMine supervised or unsupervised" → chọn Unsupervised (chỉ dùng corpus statistics).

questions.question: Among the following descriptions about SegPhrase, which one is correct?
options: SegPhrase is an unsupervised method that does not require any labeled data for phrase mining
SegPhrase is a supervised method that requires a large amount of training data in order to perform well
SegPhrase only needs a small set of training data generated by humans or a general knowledge base to achieve good performance
questions.explanation: SegPhrase is weakly/distantly supervised: a small set of labeled phrases produced by humans or extracted from a general knowledge base is enough for it to perform well.
questions.hint: SegPhrase là phương pháp weakly/distantly supervised: chỉ cần MỘT LƯỢNG NHỎ phrase gán nhãn (do người tạo hoặc lấy từ general knowledge base như Wikipedia) là đủ để chạy tốt. Quy tắc: chọn câu nói 'chỉ cần ít training data / knowledge base'. Bẫy: 'hoàn toàn unsupervised' sai (nó cần seed), 'cần lượng lớn training data' cũng sai (chỉ cần ít).
questions.trick: Thấy "SegPhrase correct description" → chọn "only needs small training data từ human/knowledge base" (weakly supervised).

questions.question: How is frequent pattern mining helpful for SegPhrase?
options: The results of frequent pattern mining can be used as candidate phrases and then later filtered
The results of frequent pattern mining are regarded as the final quality phrases
Frequent pattern mining is used only to remove stopwords before phrase mining
questions.explanation: Frequent contiguous patterns give SegPhrase a manageable set of candidate phrases, which are then scored, segmented and filtered for quality; being frequent alone does not make a good phrase.
questions.hint: Frequent pattern mining tạo cho SegPhrase một tập CANDIDATE phrase gọn (các cụm liền kề đủ tần suất), sau đó SegPhrase mới scoring, segment và LỌC chất lượng. Quy tắc: frequent chỉ là bước sàng ứng viên, không phải phrase chất lượng cuối. Bẫy: 'kết quả frequent pattern là phrase chất lượng cuối cùng' sai - tần suất cao không đồng nghĩa phrase tốt.
questions.trick: Thấy "frequent pattern mining giúp gì cho SegPhrase" → chọn "tạo candidate phrases rồi lọc sau".

questions.question: Given a support threshold σ, is Lossy Counting guaranteed to find all the frequent patterns whose supports are no smaller than σ?
questions.explanation: Lossy Counting guarantees no false negatives: all truly frequent patterns are output (it may include some false positives, but never misses a frequent pattern).
questions.hint: Lossy Counting không bỏ sót (no false negative) => tìm được hết frequent pattern. Yes.

questions.question: Which of the following is more suitable for mining "forget-to-change" bugs?
questions.explanation: "Forget-to-change" bugs involve code elements that must be updated in a particular order, so sequential pattern mining, which preserves the order of program elements, captures them better than order-less itemset mining.
questions.hint: Bug kiểu 'forget-to-change' xảy ra khi các đoạn code phải được sửa/gọi theo một THỨ TỰ nhất định mà lập trình viên quên. Vì bản chất là quan hệ có trật tự, sequential pattern mining (giữ order) phù hợp hơn frequent itemset mining (bỏ qua order). Quy tắc: đề nhấn 'thứ tự/trình tự thao tác' → chọn sequential; chỉ quan tâm 'xuất hiện cùng nhau' → itemset.
questions.trick: Thấy 'forget-to-change bugs' → chọn Sequential pattern mining (có order).

questions.question: Table 1 (transactions): T1 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T2 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T3 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T4 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T5 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}. What is the relative support and confidence of the association rule {Diapers} -> {Coffee, Nuts}?
questions.explanation: {Diapers, Coffee, Nuts} appears in T2 and T5 => support = 2/5 = 0.4. Diapers appears in T1,T2,T3,T5 (4) => confidence = 2/4 = 0.5.
questions.hint: Support = số giao dịch chứa cả 3 / tổng. Confidence = số đó / số giao dịch chứa Diapers.

questions.question: A 2x2 contingency table summarizes students taking Data Mining (DM) and Machine Learning (ML): ML row [DM 700, not-DM 300] = 1000; not-ML row [DM 500, not-DM 1500] = 2000; column totals [1200, 1800]; grand total 3000. If χ² is used to measure the correlation between DM and ML, what is the χ² score?
questions.hint: χ² = tổng (Observed - Expected)²/Expected. Expected = (tổng hàng × tổng cột)/N. Luôn dương.

questions.question: A 2x2 contingency table summarizes purchases of comics (CM) and fiction (FC) with row total FC = 700, row total not-FC = 800, and grand total 1500 (some cell values in the source are garbled). If χ² is used to measure the correlation between CM and FC, what is the χ² score?
questions.explanation: Computing χ² = Σ (Observed - Expected)²/Expected over the four cells yields 240 (χ² is always non-negative). Note: the source table cells are partly garbled, but the standard version of this problem gives 240.
questions.hint: χ² luôn ≥ 0 nên loại ngay các đáp án âm. Kết quả là 240.
questions.review: Bảng contingency mất số liệu — chọn giữa 80 và 240 là phỏng đoán.

questions.question: A 2x2 contingency table summarizes students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM), with row totals HM = 24 and not-HM = 126 (grand total 150). If lift is used to measure the correlation between HD and HM, what is the value of lift(HD, HM)?
questions.explanation: The table is constructed so that HD and HM are independent; for independent variables lift = P(HD,HM)/(P(HD)P(HM)) = 1.
questions.hint: Lift = 1 nghĩa là độc lập. Lift không thể âm nên loại -1.

questions.question: A 2x2 contingency table summarizes students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM), with row totals HM = 24 and not-HM = 126 (grand total 150). If the χ² score is used to measure the correlation between HD and HM, what is the value of the χ² score?
questions.explanation: The table is constructed so that HD and HM are independent; when observed equals expected in every cell, χ² = 0.
questions.hint: Độc lập => Observed = Expected => χ² = 0.

questions.question: Given the itemsets in Table 1 and a cluster quality measure δ = 0.001, what could be a set of representative patterns that covers all itemsets in Table 1? (Hint: the pattern with the least support is {F, A, C, E, T, S}; consider which pattern can cover it.)
options: {{F, A, C, E, S}, {F, A, C, T, S}}
{{F, A, C, E, S}, {F, A, C, E, T, S}, {F, A, C, T, S}}
questions.explanation: The full-support pattern {F,A,C,E,T,S} is too dissimilar (support gap exceeds δ) to be covered by the others, so it must be included alongside {F,A,C,E,S} and {F,A,C,T,S} to cover all itemsets.
questions.hint: Pattern có support thấp nhất {F,A,C,E,T,S} phải tự làm representative vì không pattern nào cover được nó.

questions.question: Given the sequence database: S1 <af(e)(cdeh)cfg(abe)>, S2 <ad(bc)c(fg)(ch)>, S3 <bc(ad)ebf(cdfgh)>, S4 <ab(bd)de>, with min_sup = 1. Which of the following does NOT belong to the <a>-projected database?
options: All of the above belong to the <a>-projected database.
questions.explanation: Trong <a>-projected database, mỗi sequence chỉ giữ phần hậu tố sau lần xuất hiện đầu tiên của a. Hậu tố của S4 là <b(bd)de> (không phải <b(bd)>), nên <b(bd)> là phương án KHÔNG thuộc projected database.
questions.hint: Projected DB = phần đuôi sau lần đầu xuất hiện 'a' trong mỗi sequence. <b(bd)> không khớp.

questions.question: Two samples from the Car Evaluation Database with attributes buying, maint, doors, persons, lug_boot, safety. Car 1: buying=med, maint=v-high, doors=more, persons=small(? garbled), lug_boot=small, safety=med. Car 2: buying=high, maint=v-high, doors=4, persons=(4), lug_boot=big, safety=med. Using simple matching to estimate proximity, what is the distance between Car 1 and Car 2?
questions.explanation: Simple matching distance = (number of mismatched attributes)/(total attributes). With 6 attributes, 4 mismatch (buying, doors, persons, lug_boot) while maint and safety match, giving 4/6 = 2/3.
questions.hint: Simple matching: đếm số thuộc tính khác nhau / tổng số thuộc tính = 4/6 = 2/3.

questions.question: Two samples from the Car Evaluation Database with attributes buying, maint, doors, persons, lug_boot, safety. Car 1: buying=med, maint=v-high, doors=more, persons=small(? garbled), lug_boot=small, safety=med. Car 2: buying=high, maint=v-high, doors=4, persons=(4), lug_boot=big, safety=med. To handle categorical attributes, each is represented by asymmetric binary attributes. What is the distance between Car 1 and Car 2?
questions.explanation: With asymmetric binary encoding, matching 0-0 pairs are ignored; counting only the mismatched (1-0/0-1) versus the total relevant (non 0-0) binary positions yields 8/10.
questions.hint: Asymmetric binary: bỏ qua các cặp 0-0. Tính = số khác / (số khác + số cùng 1) = 8/10.

questions.question: Cluster the following points into three clusters using k-means with Euclidean distance: A1(2,10), A2(2,5), A3(8,4), B1(5,8), B2(7,5), B3(6,4), C1(1,2), C2(4,9). Initially A1, B1, C1 are the cluster centers. What are the three final clusters?
questions.explanation: Iterating k-means from centers A1, B1, C1 converges to clusters {A1, B1, C2}, {A3, B2, B3}, and {A2, C1}, matching option 2.
questions.hint: Lặp k-means từ 3 tâm ban đầu đến khi hội tụ; kết quả {A1,B1,C2}, {A3,B2,B3}, {A2,C1}.

questions.question: What algorithm is implemented by the code below? (imports numpy and scipy cdist; randomly chooses k centroids, then computes euclidean distances between centroids and all data points and reassigns iteratively.)
questions.explanation: Randomly choosing k centroids and iteratively assigning points to the nearest centroid by Euclidean distance is the K-means algorithm.
questions.hint: Chọn k centroid ngẫu nhiên + gán theo euclidean lặp lại = K-means.

questions.question: DBLP is a computer science bibliography database. Suppose we study the correlation between authors Jure Leskovec (JL) and Hector Garcia-Molina (HG) based on co-authorship: JL & HG = 430, with a very large number of null co-occurrences (about 2.7e6). Which pattern-evaluation measure most properly reflects the collaboration proximity for pattern {JL, HG}? Check all that apply.
questions.explanation: With a huge number of null transactions, only null-invariant measures are reliable; Kulczynski is null-invariant, while Lift and χ² are distorted by the large null count.
questions.hint: Nhiều null => chọn null-invariant metric Kulczynski. Lift/χ² bị sai lệch.

questions.question: Given the sequence database S1 <a(abc)(ac)d(cf)>, S2 <(ad)c(bc)(ae)>, S3 <(ef)(ab)(df)cb>, S4 <eg(af)cbc>, which of the following belongs to the <f>-projected database?
questions.explanation: The <f>-projected database takes the suffix after the first occurrence of f. In S3 <(ef)(ab)(df)cb>, f first occurs in (ef); the suffix is <(ab)(df)cb>.
questions.hint: Projected DB lấy đuôi sau lần đầu xuất hiện 'f'. Trong S3 sau (ef) là <(ab)(df)cb>.

questions.question: Table 1 (transactions): T1 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T2 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T3 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T4 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T5 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}. Given min-support s = 40%, which of the following is a length-3 frequent itemset?
questions.explanation: min-support 40% of 5 transactions = 2. {Beer, Nuts, Diapers} occurs in T1 and T2 (count 2 = 40%), so it is frequent; the others occur in fewer than 2 transactions.
questions.hint: 40% của 5 = 2 giao dịch. {Beer,Nuts,Diapers} có ở T1, T2 => frequent.

questions.question: Consider the database with transactions T1 {a1, a2, a3}, T2 {a2, a3, a4}, T3 {a1, a3, a4}. Let min-support = 2. Which of the following frequent patterns is NOT closed?
questions.explanation: {a2} has support 2 (T1, T2), but its superset {a2, a3} also has support 2; since a superset shares the same support, {a2} is not closed.
questions.hint: Closed = không có superset cùng support. {a2} và {a2,a3} đều support 2 => {a2} không closed.

questions.question: A 2x2 contingency table summarizes students taking Data Mining (DM) and Machine Learning (ML): ML row [DM 700, not-DM 300] = 1000; not-ML row [DM 500, not-DM 1500] = 2000; column totals [1200, 1800]; grand total 3000. If lift is used to measure the correlation between DM and ML, what is the value of lift(DM, ML)?
questions.hint: Lift = P(A,B)/(P(A)P(B)). Lift luôn dương nên loại đáp án âm. Ra 7/4.

questions.question: A 2x2 contingency table summarizes students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM) with row totals HM = 24 and not-HM = 126 (grand total 150), constructed so the variables are independent. If lift is used, what is the value of lift(HD, HM)?
questions.explanation: For independent variables, lift = 1.
questions.hint: Độc lập => lift = 1.

questions.question: Given the itemsets in Table 1 and a cluster quality measure δ = 0.001, what could be a set of representative patterns that covers all itemsets in Table 1? (Hint: the least-support pattern is {F, A, C, E, T, S}; consider which pattern can cover it.)
options: {{F, A, C, E, S}, {F, A, C, T, S}}
{{F, A, C, E, S}, {F, A, C, E, T, S}, {F, A, C, T, S}}
questions.explanation: The low-support pattern {F,A,C,E,T,S} cannot be covered within δ by the others, so it must be a representative alongside {F,A,C,E,S} and {F,A,C,T,S} to cover all itemsets.
questions.hint: Pattern support thấp nhất {F,A,C,E,T,S} phải nằm trong tập representative.

questions.question: The dataset contains two flowers, Iris setosa and Iris versicolor, with (sepal length, sepal width, petal length, petal width): Iris setosa (4.9, 3.0, 1.4, 0.2), Iris versicolor (5.6, 2.5, 3.9, 1.1). What is the Manhattan distance between these two objects?
questions.hint: Manhattan = tổng trị tuyệt đối hiệu từng chiều = 4.6.

questions.question: Which of the following measures can be used as a relative measure for clustering validation?
questions.explanation: The Silhouette coefficient can be used as a relative measure to compare clusterings and choose the number of clusters, without ground truth.
questions.hint: Silhouette coefficient dùng làm relative measure (so sánh, chọn k) không cần ground-truth.

questions.question: A 2x2 contingency table summarizes students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM) with row totals HM = 24 and not-HM = 126 (grand total 150), constructed so the variables are independent. If the χ² score is used, what is the value of the χ² score?
questions.explanation: When variables are independent, observed equals expected in every cell, so χ² = 0.
questions.hint: Độc lập => Observed = Expected => χ² = 0.

questions.question: Transactions: T1{Beer,Nuts,Diapers}, T2{Beer,Coffee,Diapers,Nuts}, T3{Beer,Diapers,Eggs}, T4{Beer,Nuts,Eggs,Milk}, T5{Nuts,Coffee,Diapers,Eggs,Milk}. What are the relative support and confidence of the association rule {Diapers} -> {Coffee, Nuts}?
questions.explanation: {Diapers,Coffee,Nuts} occurs in T2 and T5, so support = 2/5 = 0.4. Diapers occurs in 4 of 5 transactions (support 0.8), so confidence = 0.4/0.8 = 0.5.
questions.hint: support = count/total transactions; confidence = support(rule)/support(ve trai). Dem transaction chua ca ba item roi chia.

questions.question: Transactions (4 rows): T1{Beer,Nuts,Diapers}, T2{Beer,Coffee,Diapers,Nuts}, T3{Beer,Diapers,Eggs}, T4{Beer,Nuts,Eggs,Milk}. With minsup s = 50% and minconf c = 50%, which of the following are valid association rules? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Nuts->Diapers has support 2/4=0.5 and confidence 2/3=0.67; Beer->Nuts has support 3/4 and confidence 3/4=0.75. Both pass minsup and minconf. (The marker only showed C, but Beer->Nuts also qualifies.)
questions.hint: Rule hop le khi support >= minsup VA confidence >= minconf. Kiem tra ca hai nguong, dung bo sot.

questions.question: Given the classic FP-tree built from frequent items {f, c, a, b, m, p}, which of the following prefix paths belong to the f-conditional pattern base (i.e. the conditional database of item f)? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: f-conditional pattern base gồm các prefix path đi qua nhánh chứa f. Nhánh {c, b, p}:1 không chứa f nên bị loại; ba phương án còn lại thuộc conditional pattern base.
questions.hint: Conditional pattern base = cac prefix path den node cua item + count cua no. Doc nguoc len goc cay.

questions.question: Coursera collected statistics on students taking Data Mining (DM) and Machine Learning (ML). Contingency table: ML&DM=700, ML&notDM=300 (row 1000); notML&DM=500, notML&notDM=1500 (row 2000); column totals 1200 and 1800, grand total 3000. If chi-square is used to measure the correlation between DM and ML, what is the chi-square score?
questions.hint: chi-square = Sigma(O-E)^2/E, E = (row total * col total)/grand total. Ket qua luon duong.

questions.question: A school collected data on students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM). Contingency table (grand total 150): HM&HD=4, HM&notHD=20 (row HM=24); notHM&HD=21, notHM&notHD=105 (row notHM=126); column totals HD=25, notHD=125. If lift is used to measure the correlation between HD and HM, what is lift(HD, HM)?
questions.explanation: P(HD,HM)=4/150 and P(HD)*P(HM)=(25/150)*(24/150)=4/150, so observed equals expected. HD and HM are independent, giving lift = 1.
questions.hint: lift = P(A,B)/(P(A)*P(B)). Neu bang expected (doc lap) thi lift = 1.

questions.question: A school collected data on students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM). Contingency table (grand total 150): HM&HD=4, HM&notHD=20 (row HM=24); notHM&HD=21, notHM&notHD=105 (row notHM=126); column totals HD=25, notHD=125. If chi-square is used to measure the correlation between HD and HM, what is the chi-square score?
questions.explanation: Every observed cell equals its expected value (independence), so each (O-E)^2/E term is 0 and chi-square = 0.
questions.hint: chi-square = Sigma(O-E)^2/E. Neu O = E o moi o (doc lap) thi chi-square = 0.

questions.question: Given the itemsets in Table 1 and a pattern-cluster quality threshold delta = 0.001, which set of representative (compressed) patterns covers all itemsets in Table 1? Hint: the pattern with the least support is {F,A,C,E,T,S}; consider which pattern can delta-cover it.
questions.explanation: A representative-pattern set must delta-cover every frequent itemset. The lowest-support pattern {F,A,C,E,T,S} is not delta-covered by the others, so it must be kept, giving the three-pattern set in option B.
questions.hint: Representative pattern phai delta-cover tat ca itemset. Pattern support thap nhat khong bi cover thi phai giu lai.

questions.question: Given the sequence database (Table 3) with min_sup = 1, which of the following sequences does NOT belong to the <a>-projected (a-prefix) database?
options: All of the above belong to the <a>-projected database.
questions.explanation: The <a>-projected database consists of the suffixes obtained after the first occurrence of 'a' in each sequence; <b(bd)> is not one of those valid projected suffixes.
questions.hint: <a>-projected DB = phan hau to sau lan xuat hien dau tien cua 'a'. Cai nao khong phai suffix hop le thi loai.
questions.review: Thiếu Table 3 của sequence database.

questions.question: Using the CloSpan algorithm with minimum support 15, mining produces these sequences with their projected-DB sizes: <c>:50, <ac>:40, <ab>:30, <bc>:50. After applying the backward sub-pattern and backward super-pattern pruning rules, which projected DBs remain? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: <c> and its super-pattern <bc> have the same projected-DB size (50), so <c> is absorbed/pruned. The remaining projected DBs are <ac>, <ab> and <bc>.
questions.hint: CloSpan: neu super-pattern co cung kich thuoc projected DB voi sub-pattern thi sub-pattern bi prune (khong closed).

questions.question: For mining text data, which of the following algorithms will NOT output phrases?
questions.explanation: LDA is a bag-of-words topic model whose topics are distributions over individual words; KERT, PDLDA and ToPMine are all designed to produce phrase-level output.
questions.hint: LDA là topic model kiểu bag-of-words: mỗi topic là phân phối trên TỪ ĐƠN (unigram), nên KHÔNG xuất ra phrase. KERT, PDLDA, ToPMine đều thiết kế để cho ra phrase (cụm nhiều từ). Quy tắc: hỏi thuật toán nào KHÔNG ra phrase → chọn LDA. Bẫy: PDLDA nghe giống LDA nhưng nó là phrasal topic model, vẫn ra phrase.
questions.trick: Thấy "NOT output phrases" (KERT/LDA/PDLDA/ToPMine) → chọn LDA (bag-of-words, chỉ unigram).

questions.question: A data scientist applies the Lossy Counting algorithm to a transactional data stream to estimate item counts. Bucket size w = 1000, total stream length N = 10000, and the true count of item A is 100. Which of the following could be a possible output count for item A from Lossy Counting?
questions.explanation: Lossy Counting never overcounts and undercounts by at most N/w = 10, so the estimate lies in [90, 100]. Only 95 falls in this range.
questions.hint: Lossy Counting chi under-count, sai so <= N/w. Uoc luong nam trong [true - N/w, true]. Loai cac gia tri > true.

questions.question: Two cars from the Car Evaluation Database have 6 categorical attributes (buying, maint, doors, persons, lug_boot, safety). Car 1 and Car 2 agree on 2 attributes (maint = v-high, safety = med) and differ on the other 4. Using simple matching to estimate proximity, what is the distance between Car 1 and Car 2?
questions.explanation: Simple-matching distance = (number of mismatched attributes)/(total attributes) = 4/6 = 2/3.
questions.hint: Simple match distance = so thuoc tinh khac / tong so thuoc tinh. Dem so cot khac nhau roi chia.

questions.question: The MLE objective is to find parameters maximizing the likelihood of observed data drawn from a Gaussian. For D = {-4, 5, 14}, which parameter set (mu, sigma) produces the maximum L(N(mu, sigma^2) | D)?
questions.explanation: MLE mu = mean = 5 and MLE sigma = sqrt(162/3) approx 7.35. Among the choices with mu=5, sigma=9 gives a higher log-likelihood than sigma=4, so (mu=5, sigma=9) is best.
questions.hint: MLE Gaussian: mu = trung binh, sigma = do lech chuan mau. Chon dap an co mu dung va sigma gan nhat.

questions.question: The MLE objective is to find parameters maximizing the likelihood of observed data drawn from a Gaussian. For D = {-5, 5, 15}, which parameter set (mu, sigma) produces the maximum L(N(mu, sigma^2) | D)?
questions.explanation: MLE mu = mean = 5 and MLE sigma = sqrt(200/3) approx 8.16. Among the choices with mu=5, sigma=10 yields a higher likelihood than sigma=5, so (mu=5, sigma=10) is best.
questions.hint: MLE Gaussian: mu = trung binh mau (=5). Sau do chon sigma gan do lech chuan mau nhat.

questions.question: The MLE objective is to find parameters maximizing the likelihood of observed data drawn from a Gaussian. For D = {-1, 0, 1}, which parameter set (mu, sigma) produces the maximum L(N(mu, sigma^2) | D)?
questions.explanation: MLE mu = mean = 0 and MLE sigma = sqrt(2/3) approx 0.82. sigma=0 is invalid; between sigma=1 and sigma=2, sigma=1 gives higher likelihood, so (mu=0, sigma=1) is best.
questions.hint: MLE Gaussian: mu = trung binh (=0). sigma khong the bang 0; chon sigma gan do lech chuan mau nhat.

questions.question: Consider this Python snippet: it randomly chooses k initial centroids from the data, computes Euclidean distances (cdist) between all points and the centroids, assigns points to the nearest centroid, and iterates. Which algorithm does this implement?
questions.explanation: Randomly initializing k centroids, assigning each point to the nearest centroid by Euclidean distance, and iterating is the K-means algorithm.
questions.hint: Chon k centroid ngau nhien + gan diem theo khoang cach Euclidean + lap lai = K-means.

questions.question: The table lists all frequent patterns: {Beer,Nuts,Diaper}, {Beer,Coffee,Nuts}, {Beer,Diaper,Eggs}, {Beer,Nuts,Eggs,Milk}, {Beer,Nuts,Diaper,Eggs,Milk}. Which of them are closed patterns but NOT max patterns? Check all that apply. (Closed: no proper superset with the same support. Max: no frequent proper superset.)
questions.explanation: {Beer,Nuts,Eggs,Milk} and {Beer,Nuts,Diaper} are closed (no superset with equal support) but each has a frequent superset ({Beer,Nuts,Diaper,Eggs,Milk}), so they are not max patterns.
questions.hint: Closed nhung khong max = closed VA van co superset la frequent. Tim pattern nho hon nam trong pattern lon nhat.
questions.review: Thiếu cột support của bảng — 3 phương án cùng thoả cách đọc thông thường.

questions.question: DBLP is a computer science bibliography database. We study the collaboration between authors Jure Leskovec (JL) and Hector Garcia-Molina (HG) via co-authorship. The contingency table is extremely skewed with a very large number of null transactions (papers by neither author). Which pattern-evaluation measure most properly reflects the collaboration proximity of {JL, HG}? Check all that apply.
questions.explanation: With many null transactions, Lift and chi-square are not null-invariant and become misleading. Kulczynski is a null-invariant measure and properly reflects the association.
questions.hint: Nhieu null transaction thi dung null-invariant metric (Kulczynski, cosine...). Lift va chi-square bi anh huong boi null.

questions.question: Consider support-based and null-invariant definitions for negative patterns, with epsilon = 0.01. In a database of 10^9 total transactions, 10^6 contain item A, 10^4 contain item B, and 10^2 contain both A and B. Which statement is true?
options: {A, B} is a negative pattern only by the null-invariant definition.
(P(B|A)+P(A|B))/2 = (10^-4 + 10^-2)/2 = 0.00505 < 0.01, so {A,B} is negative by the null-invariant definition (and this makes it negative overall).
{A, B} is not a negative pattern by either definition.
{A, B} is a negative pattern by both definitions.
{A, B} is a negative pattern only by the support-based definition.
questions.explanation: P(A,B)=10^-7 while P(A)P(B)=10^-8, so P(A,B) exceeds the independence value and it is NOT negative by the support-based definition. The null-invariant average (P(B|A)+P(A|B))/2 = 0.00505 < 0.01, so it is negative only by the null-invariant definition.
questions.hint: Support-based: P(A,B) << P(A)*P(B) => negative. Null-invariant: (P(A|B)+P(B|A))/2 < epsilon => negative. So sanh tung dinh nghia.

questions.question: Which one of the following 3-D depth cues is the strongest?
questions.explanation: Occlusion (one object blocking another) is the strongest and most reliable depth cue for perceiving 3-D ordering.
questions.hint: Occlusion (vat che khuat vat khac) la depth cue manh nhat trong truc quan hoa 3-D.

questions.question: Transactions: T1{Beer,Nuts,Diapers}, T2{Beer,Coffee,Diapers,Nuts}, T3{Beer,Diapers,Eggs}, T4{Beer,Nuts,Eggs,Milk}, T5{Nuts,Coffee,Diapers,Eggs,Milk}. With minsup s = 40% (i.e. 2 of 5 transactions), which of the following is a length-3 frequent itemset?
questions.explanation: {Beer,Nuts,Diapers} occurs in T1 and T2 (support 2/5 = 40%), meeting minsup. The other itemsets each occur in at most 1 transaction.
questions.hint: Length-3 frequent = itemset 3 phan tu co count >= minsup. Dem so transaction chua ca 3 item.

questions.question: Consider the database with transactions T1: {a1,a2,a3}, T2: {a2,a3,a4}, T3: {a1,a3,a4}. With minsup = 2, which of the following frequent patterns is NOT closed?
questions.explanation: {a2} has support 2, but its superset {a2,a3} also has support 2, so {a2} is not closed. The others have no proper superset with equal support.
questions.hint: Not closed = ton tai superset Y voi sup(Y) = sup(X). Kiem tra tung item xem co superset cung support khong.

questions.question: Coursera collected statistics on students taking Data Mining (DM) and Machine Learning (ML). Contingency table: ML&DM=700, ML&notDM=300 (row 1000); notML&DM=500, notML&notDM=1500 (row 2000); column totals 1200 and 1800; grand total 3000. If lift is used to measure the correlation between DM and ML, what is lift(DM, ML)?
questions.hint: lift = P(A,B)/(P(A)*P(B)). lift > 1 => tuong quan duong. Ket qua 7/4.

questions.question: A school collected data on students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM). The 2x2 contingency table (grand total 150) is constructed so that HM=24, notHM=126, HD=25, notHD=125, with observed counts equal to expected. If lift is used to measure the correlation between HD and HM, what is lift(HD, HM)?
questions.explanation: Since observed counts equal the expected (independence) values, P(HD,HM)=P(HD)*P(HM) and lift = 1.
questions.hint: Doc lap => lift = 1. lift = P(A,B)/(P(A)*P(B)).

questions.question: Given the itemsets in Table 1 and a pattern-cluster quality threshold delta = 0.001, which set of representative (compressed) patterns covers all itemsets in Table 1? The lowest-support pattern is {F,A,C,E,T,S}.
questions.explanation: The lowest-support pattern {F,A,C,E,T,S} cannot be delta-covered by the others and must be kept, yielding the three-pattern representative set in option B.
questions.hint: Representative pattern phai delta-cover moi itemset. Pattern support thap nhat phai giu neu khong bi cover.

questions.question: Given the sequence database S1: <a(bc)(de)ef>, S2: <a(bd)(be)ef>, S3: <bc(ad)ebfed>, S4: <ab(cd)d(ab)e>, using the SPADE algorithm, which sequence positions in the format <SID, EID> belong to the id-list of item b? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Trong S1, b nằm ở element thứ 2 → <1,2>; trong S3, b nằm ở element đầu → <3,1>. Đây là hai vị trí đúng trong id-list của b (bản đề gốc chép thiếu b ở S1).
questions.hint: SPADE id-list = danh sach (SID, EID) noi item xuat hien. Xac dinh dung vi tri event (EID) cua item b.

questions.question: Given the sequence database (Table 3) with min_sup = 1, which of the following sequences does NOT belong to the <a>-projected database?
options: All of the above belong to the <a>-projected database.
questions.explanation: The <a>-projected database contains the suffixes after the first 'a' in each sequence; <b(bd)> is not a valid projected suffix.
questions.hint: <a>-projected DB = suffix sau lan dau xuat hien 'a'. Cai nao khong phai suffix hop le thi loai.
questions.review: Trùng dbm302m-163, thiếu Table 3.

questions.question: Given the sequence database S1: <a c (de) e f>, S2: <a (bd) (be) e f>, S3: <b c (ad) e b f e d>, S4: <a b (cd) d (ab) e>, using the SPADE algorithm, which sequence positions in the format <SID, EID> belong to the id-list of item a? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Item a occurs at event 1 of S4 (<4,1>) and event 1 of S1 (<1,1>). In S3 the element (ad) is event 3 (b and c are separate earlier events), so <3,2> is not an a-position, and <1,2> of S1 is (de).
questions.hint: SPADE id-list cua a = cac (SID, EID) noi a xuat hien. Dem event id can than khi item roi hoac trong ngoac.

questions.question: In CP-Miner, constraint-based sequential pattern mining is used on a tokenized/hashed source file. Sequences: (1)<1,2,1,3>, (2)<2,3,1,4>, (3)<1,2,4,3>, (4)<3,2,4,3>, (5)<1,2,5,4>. With max_gap = 2 (index difference between matched items <= 2) and support threshold 0.6 (i.e. at least 3 of 5), which sequences can be frequent output by CP-Miner? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: <1,2> occurs with gap<=2 in sequences 1,3,5 (support 3); <2,3> occurs in sequences 1,2,3,4 (support 4). <1,3> and <3,4> each appear in fewer than 3 sequences.
questions.hint: Dem so sequence chua pattern voi max_gap <= 2, roi so voi nguong support (3/5). Chu y thu tu va khoang cach chi so.

questions.question: What are some common considerations and requirements for cluster analysis? Select all that apply.
options: In order to perform cluster analysis, we need a similarity measure between data objects.
We need to be able to handle a mixture of different attribute types (e.g. numerical and categorical).
We need to consider how to incorporate user preference for cluster size and shape into the algorithm.
We must know the number of output clusters a priori for all clustering algorithms.
questions.explanation: A similarity measure, support for mixed attribute types and the ability to reflect user preferences on cluster size/shape are genuine requirements. Knowing k in advance is not required by all algorithms (DBSCAN and hierarchical methods do not need it).
questions.hint: Yêu cầu thật của cluster analysis: cần similarity measure, xử lý được attribute hỗn hợp (numeric + categorical), và phản ánh được user preference về kích thước/hình dạng cụm. Quy tắc: cảnh giác với phát biểu tuyệt đối. Bẫy: 'phải biết trước số cluster k cho MỌI thuật toán' là sai vì DBSCAN và hierarchical không cần k trước.
questions.trick: Thấy 'must know number of output clusters a priori for ALL' → loại; chọn 3 câu còn lại.

questions.question: A dataset contains two flowers. Iris setosa: (sepal length 4.9, sepal width 3.0, petal length 1.4, petal width 0.2). Iris versicolor: (5.6, 2.5, 3.9, 1.1). What is the Manhattan distance between these two objects?
questions.hint: Manhattan distance = tong tri tuyet doi hieu tung chieu (L1). Cong lai la ra.

questions.question: Two cars from the Car Evaluation Database have 6 categorical attributes (buying[4 values], maint[4], doors[4], persons[3], lug_boot[3], safety[3]). Each categorical attribute is represented by a set of symmetric binary attributes (21 in total). The two cars agree on 2 attributes (maint, safety) and differ on 4. What is the distance between Car 1 and Car 2?
questions.explanation: One-hot encoding gives 21 binary attributes. Each differing categorical attribute contributes 2 mismatched binary attributes, so 4 differing attributes give 8 mismatches. Symmetric binary distance = 8/21.
questions.hint: Moi categorical -> nhieu binary; moi thuoc tinh khac nhau tao 2 mismatch. Symmetric binary distance = mismatch/tong binary = 8/21.

questions.question: The table lists all frequent patterns: {Beer,Nuts,Diaper}, {Beer,Coffee,Nuts}, {Beer,Diaper,Eggs}, {Beer,Nuts,Eggs,Milk}, {Beer,Nuts,Diaper,Eggs,Milk}. Which of them are closed patterns but NOT max patterns? Check all that apply.
questions.explanation: {Beer,Nuts,Eggs,Milk} and {Beer,Nuts,Diaper} are closed but each has a frequent superset ({Beer,Nuts,Diaper,Eggs,Milk}), so they are not max patterns.
questions.hint: Closed nhung khong max = van co superset la frequent. Tim pattern nam trong pattern lon nhat.
questions.review: Trùng dbm302m-172, thiếu số liệu support.

questions.question: Consider support-based and null-invariant definitions for negative patterns with epsilon = 0.01. In a database of 10^9 total transactions, 10^6 contain A, 10^4 contain B, and 10^2 contain both. Which statement is true?
options: {A, B} is a negative pattern only by the null-invariant definition.
(P(B|A)+P(A|B))/2 = 0.00505 < 0.01, so it is negative by the null-invariant definition (and this makes it negative overall).
{A, B} is not a negative pattern by either definition.
{A, B} is a negative pattern by both definitions.
{A, B} is a negative pattern only by the support-based definition.
questions.explanation: P(A,B)=10^-7 > P(A)P(B)=10^-8, so not negative by support-based. The null-invariant average = 0.00505 < 0.01, so negative only by the null-invariant definition.
questions.hint: Support-based: P(A,B) << P(A)*P(B). Null-invariant: (P(A|B)+P(B|A))/2 < epsilon. Chi thoa null-invariant.

questions.question: Sequence database: S1: <a(abc)(ac)d(cf)>, S2: <(ad)c(bc)(ae)>, S3: <(ef)(ab)(df)cb>, S4: <eg(af)cbc>. Which of the following is NOT a subsequence of any sequence in the database?
questions.explanation: <aa(bc)> requires two a's followed by an element containing both b and c together; no sequence provides a later single element with both b and c after two a's. The others are subsequences (e.g. <abcd> and <accc> in S1, <f(ba)fb> in S3).
questions.hint: Subsequence phai giu thu tu; item trong ngoac phai cung mot element. Kiem tra tung sequence.

questions.question: A school collected data on students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM). The 2x2 contingency table (grand total 150) is built with HM=24, notHM=126 and observed counts equal to expected. If lift is used to measure the correlation between HD and HM, what is lift(HD, HM)?
questions.explanation: Observed equals expected, so HD and HM are independent and lift = 1.
questions.hint: Doc lap (O = E) => lift = 1.

questions.question: A school collected data on students' preference for hot dogs (HD) vs hamburgers (HM). The 2x2 contingency table (grand total 150) has observed counts equal to expected (HM=24, notHM=126). If the chi-square score is used to measure the correlation between HD and HM, what is the chi-square score?
questions.explanation: Because observed equals expected in every cell, each (O-E)^2/E term is 0 and chi-square = 0.
questions.hint: O = E o moi o => chi-square = 0.

questions.question: Using the CloSpan algorithm with minimum support 15, mining derives sequences with projected-DB sizes: <c>:50, <ac>:40, <ab>:30, <bc>:50. After applying the backward sub-pattern and backward super-pattern pruning rules, which projected DBs remain? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: <c> and its super-pattern <bc> share the same projected-DB size (50), so <c> is pruned; <ac>, <ab> and <bc> remain.
questions.hint: CloSpan: super-pattern cung kich thuoc projected DB => prune sub-pattern <c>.

questions.question: A data scientist applies the Lossy Counting algorithm to a transactional data stream. Bucket size w = 1000, stream length N = 10000, and the true count of item A is 100. Which of the following could be a possible output count for item A?
questions.explanation: The maximum undercount is N/w = 10, and overcounting is impossible, so the estimate must be in [90, 100]. Only 95 qualifies.
questions.hint: Error bound của Lossy Counting là N/w = 10000/1000 = 10, và không bao giờ overcount, nên output phải thuộc [true count − N/w, true count] = [90, 100]. Bước: tính N/w trước, rồi lọc đáp án. Bẫy: các giá trị lớn hơn true count (như 105, 110) là bất khả vì thuật toán chỉ đếm thiếu; giá trị dưới 90 thì vượt cận.
questions.trick: Calc: N/w=10 → [90,100] → chỉ 95 hợp lệ.

questions.question: The Kohonen self-organizing map (SOM) refers to which of the following?
options: The process of finding the right formal representation of a body of knowledge in order to represent it in a knowledge-based system.
A method that automatically maps an external signal space into a system's internal representational space; useful for classification tasks.
A process where an individual learns to carry out a task, transitioning from being unable to a being able to perform it under the same circumstances.
questions.explanation: A Kohonen SOM is an unsupervised neural network that maps a high-dimensional external signal space onto a low-dimensional internal representation, useful for classification and visualization.
questions.hint: SOM (Kohonen) = mang neural anh xa khong gian tin hieu ngoai vao khong gian bieu dien noi bo, ho tro phan loai.

questions.question: Which statement best describes a brute-force (exhaustive) search?
options: A stage of the KDD process in which new data is added to the existing selection.
The process of finding a solution to a problem by enumerating all possible solutions in some predefined order and then testing them.
The distance between two points as calculated using the Pythagorean theorem.
questions.explanation: A brute-force (exhaustive) search enumerates all candidate solutions in a fixed order and tests each until a valid one is found.
questions.hint: Brute-force = liet ke va thu tat ca giai phap theo thu tu. (Option C mo ta Euclidean distance, khong phai brute-force.)

questions.question: Discriminating between spam and ham (legitimate) e-mails is a classification task. True or false?
questions.explanation: Assigning e-mails to predefined categories (spam vs ham) using labeled data is a supervised classification task.
questions.hint: Phan loai email spam/ham = gan nhan lop da biet => classification (supervised).

questions.question: Points (2,3), (4,5), and (6,7) belong to a cluster. What is the centroid x-coordinate?
questions.explanation: The centroid x-coordinate is the mean of the x values: (2+4+6)/3 = 4.
questions.hint: Centroid là điểm trung tâm của cluster, mỗi tọa độ tính độc lập bằng trung bình cộng. Công thức: x_c = (Σ xᵢ)/n. Bước làm: chỉ cộng riêng các giá trị x rồi chia số điểm, bỏ qua y hoàn toàn. Ở đây (2+4+6)/3. Bẫy: đừng gộp cả x lẫn y, và đừng lấy trung vị (median) thay vì mean.

questions.question: Which stage presents mining results using charts, dashboards, or reports?
questions.explanation: Knowledge (result) visualization is the stage where mining results are communicated through charts, dashboards, and reports.
questions.hint: Đây là bước cuối của quy trình data mining: biến kết quả (knowledge) thành charts/dashboards/reports để người dùng hiểu. Quy tắc: thấy 'present results bằng biểu đồ/báo cáo' thì chọn Knowledge (result) visualization. Bẫy: encryption là bảo mật, memory allocation là kỹ thuật hệ thống, data extracting là lấy dữ liệu đầu vào chứ không phải trình bày kết quả.
questions.trick: Thấy 'presents mining results using charts, dashboards, or reports' → chọn 'Knowledge visualization'.

questions.question: If SSE decreases after centroid updates, what does it indicate?
questions.explanation: Lower SSE (sum of squared errors) means points are closer to their centroids, so the clustering is improving.
questions.hint: SSE (Sum of Squared Errors) đo tổng bình phương khoảng cách từ mỗi điểm tới centroid của nó; SSE càng nhỏ nghĩa là các điểm càng sát tâm. Quy tắc dễ nhớ: error giảm luôn là dấu hiệu tốt lên. Sau mỗi lần cập nhật centroid trong K-Means, SSE giảm cho thấy cụm chặt hơn. Bẫy: SSE giảm không liên quan gì tới kích thước dataset hay normalization.
questions.trick: Thấy 'SSE decreases after centroid updates' → error giảm là tốt → chọn 'Clusters are improving'.

questions.question: Of the listed benefits of a fisheye lens, which is the least relevant to data visualization?
options: It makes the data appear more interesting.
It supports focus on detail along with the context of that detail amid the rest of the dataset.
It allows zooming without obscuring the unzoomed data.
questions.explanation: A fisheye lens' real value is focus-plus-context and non-obscuring zoom; merely making data look interesting is not a substantive visualization benefit.
questions.hint: Giá trị thực của fisheye lens là focus + context (phóng to chi tiết mà vẫn giữ được bối cảnh xung quanh) và zoom không che dữ liệu khác. Đây là câu hỏi 'ít liên quan nhất', nên hãy loại các lợi ích kỹ thuật thật và chọn cái chỉ mang tính thẩm mỹ/cảm tính. Bẫy: đọc kỹ chữ 'least relevant' — dễ chọn nhầm sang phương án đúng đắn nhất.
questions.trick: Thấy 'fisheye lens... least relevant' → chọn 'It makes the data appear more interesting' (chỉ bề nổi).

questions.question: Which techniques help analyze correlations between multiple numerical variables? (Choose 2 answers)
questions.explanation: A scatter plot matrix and a correlation heatmap both reveal pairwise relationships among multiple numerical variables; histograms and line charts show single-variable distributions or trends.
questions.hint: Muốn xem tương quan giữa nhiều biến số (pairwise) cần công cụ hiển thị quan hệ từng cặp: scatter plot matrix (ma trận scatter) và correlation heatmap (bảng màu hệ số r). Quy tắc: từ khóa 'correlation giữa nhiều biến' → chọn hai loại này. Bẫy: histogram chỉ mô tả phân phối một biến, line chart chỉ thể hiện xu hướng theo thời gian, đều không cho thấy quan hệ giữa các biến.
questions.trick: Thấy 'correlations between multiple numerical variables (Choose 2)' → chọn 'Scatter plot matrix' + 'Correlation heatmap'.

questions.question: If support(A)=0.5, support(B)=0.4, and support(A,B)=0.2, what is confidence(A→B)?
questions.explanation: Confidence(A→B) = support(A,B)/support(A) = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4.
questions.hint: Confidence(A→B) là xác suất có B khi đã có A, công thức: confidence = support(A,B)/support(A). Mẫu số LUÔN là vế trái của mũi tên (A). Ở đây lấy 0.2 chia 0.5. Bẫy hay gặp: đảo mẫu số thành support(B), hoặc nhầm với lift (lift còn chia thêm cho support(B)).
questions.trick: Thấy 'support(A)=0.5... support(A,B)=0.2... confidence(A→B)' → 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 → chọn 0.4.

questions.question: A dataset has 1000 records visualized in a pie chart with 200 belonging to category A. What percentage does category A represent?
questions.hint: Phần trăm một category trong pie chart = phần/tổng × 100%. Bước: chia số phần tử của A cho tổng số record rồi nhân 100. Ở đây 200/1000. Bẫy: nhớ tổng là toàn bộ dataset, không phải tổng các category còn lại, và đọc kỹ số để không nhầm 100 với 1000.
questions.trick: Thấy '1000 records... 200 category A, pie chart' → 200/1000 = 20% → chọn 20%.

questions.question: Which type of pattern represents sequential relationships between events?
questions.explanation: Sequential patterns capture ordered relationships between events over time.
questions.hint: Sequential patterns mô tả quan hệ có thứ tự thời gian giữa các sự kiện (mua X rồi sau đó mua Y). Quy tắc: nghe 'sequential/ordered/theo trình tự' thì chọn Sequential patterns (sequential pattern mining). Bẫy: regression là dự đoán giá trị, normalization là chuẩn hóa dữ liệu, sorting chỉ là sắp xếp — không phải khai phá mẫu tuần tự.
questions.trick: Thấy 'sequential relationships between events' → chọn 'Sequential patterns' (nghe sequential chọn sequential).

questions.question: Which characteristics describe effective clusters? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Good clusters have high similarity within a cluster, low similarity between clusters, and clear boundaries; random assignment and high noise indicate poor clustering.
questions.hint: Cluster tốt tuân theo nguyên tắc: giống nhau cao bên trong nhóm (high intra-cluster similarity), khác biệt cao giữa các nhóm (low inter-cluster similarity), và ranh giới rõ ràng. Quy tắc chọn: giữ 3 đặc điểm chất lượng, loại mọi thứ mang tính 'random' hay 'noise'. Bẫy: random assignment và high noise luôn là dấu hiệu clustering kém, không bao giờ là câu đúng.
questions.trick: Thấy 'effective clusters (Choose 3)' → chọn 'High intra', 'Low inter', 'Clear cluster boundaries'; bỏ random/noise.

questions.question: A dataset initially has 10 features. After dimensionality reduction it has 4 features. How many features were eliminated?
questions.explanation: 10 - 4 = 6 features were eliminated.
questions.hint: Số feature bị loại = số ban đầu − số còn lại (dimensionality reduction giảm số chiều). Ở đây 10 − 4. Bước cực đơn giản nhưng đọc kỹ đề hỏi 'bị loại' hay 'còn lại'. Bẫy: dễ chọn nhầm 4 (số còn lại) thay vì hiệu số 6.
questions.trick: Thấy '10 features → 4 features, eliminated' → 10-4 = 6 → chọn 6.

questions.question: If support(A)=0.4, support(B)=0.5, and support(A,B)=0.2, what is lift(A→B)?
questions.explanation: Lift = support(A,B)/(support(A)*support(B)) = 0.2/(0.4*0.5) = 0.2/0.2 = 1.0, indicating independence.
questions.hint: Lift đo mức A và B xuất hiện cùng nhau so với kỳ vọng nếu độc lập. Công thức: lift(A→B) = support(A,B)/(support(A)×support(B)). Bước: nhân hai support đơn ở mẫu rồi lấy support chung chia. Ý nghĩa: lift = 1 → độc lập, >1 → hút nhau (positive), <1 → đẩy nhau. Bẫy: đừng nhầm mẫu số với chỉ support(A) như confidence.

questions.question: From the following list of statements, identify the factually correct ones.
options: Dimensionality reduction helps make high-dimensional clustering more feasible and scalable.
There are no clustering algorithms that can handle time-series data since we always assume that the data points are temporally independent from each other.
Since cluster analysis is unsupervised learning, there's no way to incorporate user preference or guidance into the clustering process.
questions.explanation: Dimensionality reduction improves feasibility and scalability of clustering; B and C are false (time-series clustering exists and semi-supervised/constrained clustering can use guidance).
questions.hint: Chọn câu ĐÚNG về mặt sự thật: dimensionality reduction thật sự giúp clustering high-dimensional khả thi và scalable hơn. Quy tắc mẹo: câu chứa từ tuyệt đối như 'always', 'no way', 'there are no' thường sai. Bẫy: có time-series clustering, và constrained/semi-supervised clustering cho phép đưa user guidance vào — nên hai câu phủ định tuyệt đối kia đều sai.
questions.trick: Thấy câu chứa 'no clustering... always temporally independent' + 'no way to incorporate guidance' → sai; chọn 'Dimensionality reduction helps... feasible and scalable'.

questions.question: If support(A,B)=0.3 and support(A)=0.6, what is confidence(A→B)?
questions.explanation: Confidence(A→B) = support(A,B)/support(A) = 0.3/0.6 = 0.5.
questions.hint: Confidence(A→B) = support(A,B)/support(A), mẫu số là vế trái A. Ở đây 0.3/0.6. Bước: lấy support chung chia cho support của tiền đề. Bẫy: nhớ luôn chia cho support(A), không phải support(B); và kết quả confidence luôn nằm trong [0,1].
questions.trick: Thấy 'support(A,B)=0.3, support(A)=0.6, confidence(A→B)' → 0.3/0.6 = 0.5 → chọn 0.50.

questions.question: Which pattern discovery method finds relationships among variables in large databases?
questions.explanation: Association rule mining discovers relationships/associations among variables (items) in large databases.
questions.hint: Tìm 'relationships among variables/items trong CSDL lớn' chính là Association rule mining (khám phá luật kết hợp, ví dụ kinh điển bia–tã lót). Quy tắc: từ khóa 'relationships/associations among items' → chọn phương án này. Bẫy: feature encoding là biến đổi dữ liệu, query optimization thuộc CSDL, encryption là bảo mật — không phải khai phá mẫu.
questions.trick: Thấy 'finds relationships among variables in large databases' → chọn 'Association rule mining'.

questions.question: Which characteristics make a visualization effective for data mining analysis? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Effective visualizations use clear labels, an appropriate chart type, and minimal data distortion; random colors reduce clarity.
questions.hint: Visualization hiệu quả cần: nhãn rõ ràng (clear labeling), chọn đúng loại biểu đồ (appropriate chart type), và ít bóp méo dữ liệu (minimal distortion). Quy tắc: giữ các yếu tố phục vụ tính chính xác và dễ đọc, loại yếu tố tùy tiện. Bẫy: 'random color selection' làm giảm sự rõ ràng nên luôn là đáp án sai.
questions.trick: Thấy 'effective visualization (Choose 3)' → chọn 'Clear labeling', 'Appropriate chart type', 'Minimal distortion'; bỏ random color.

questions.question: A cluster contains distances 1, 2, 3, 4 from centroid. What is the average distance?
questions.hint: Khoảng cách trung bình = tổng các khoảng cách/số điểm. Ở đây (1+2+3+4)/4 = 10/4. Bước: cộng hết rồi chia số lượng. Bẫy: đừng nhầm với trung vị (median của 1,2,3,4 cũng là 2.5 trùng hợp, nhưng hãy dùng mean); và đừng quên chia cho đúng số phần tử.
questions.trick: Thấy 'distances 1,2,3,4 from centroid, average' → 10/4 = 2.5 → chọn 2.5.

questions.question: In a dataset with 300 transactions, item A appears in 90 transactions. What is support(A)?
questions.hint: Support(A) = số transaction chứa A/tổng số transaction, đo mức phổ biến của item. Ở đây 90/300. Bước: lấy tần suất chia tổng. Bẫy: mẫu số là TỔNG số transaction (300), không phải số transaction còn lại; đừng nhầm support với confidence.
questions.trick: Thấy '300 transactions, A in 90, support(A)' → 90/300 = 0.30 → chọn 0.30.

questions.question: Which clustering algorithm requires the number of clusters to be specified beforehand?
questions.explanation: K-Means requires k (the number of clusters) as input; DBSCAN and OPTICS are density-based and do not, and agglomerative builds a hierarchy without a preset k.
questions.hint: K-Means bắt buộc khai báo trước số cụm k (chữ 'K' chính là số cluster). DBSCAN và OPTICS là density-based, tự suy ra số cụm từ mật độ; Agglomerative xây cây phân cấp rồi mới cắt, không cần k cố định ban đầu. Quy tắc: hỏi 'cần biết trước số cluster' → nghĩ ngay K-Means. Bẫy: đừng chọn nhầm các thuật toán density-based.
questions.trick: Thấy 'requires the number of clusters beforehand' → chữ K = k → chọn 'K-Means'.

questions.question: A dataset with 600 samples is visualized using a pie chart. If category A contains 150 samples, what percentage does category A represent?
questions.hint: Phần trăm category = phần/tổng × 100%. Ở đây 150/600. Bước: chia số mẫu của A cho tổng số mẫu rồi nhân 100. Bẫy: tổng là toàn bộ dataset (600), đọc kỹ số để không rút gọn sai phân số.
questions.trick: Thấy '600 samples... 150 category A, pie chart' → 150/600 = 25% → chọn 25%.

questions.question: Which techniques are used for dimensionality reduction before visualization? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP are dimensionality reduction techniques; linear regression is a predictive/regression method.
questions.hint: Dimensionality reduction để trực quan hóa gồm bộ ba quen thuộc: PCA (tuyến tính, giữ variance), t-SNE và UMAP (phi tuyến, giữ cấu trúc cục bộ). Quy tắc: hỏi 'giảm chiều trước khi visualize' → chọn ba thuật toán này. Bẫy: linear regression là phương pháp dự đoán/hồi quy, hoàn toàn không phải kỹ thuật giảm chiều.
questions.trick: Thấy 'dimensionality reduction before visualization (Choose 3)' → chọn 'PCA', 't-SNE', 'UMAP'; bỏ linear regression.

questions.question: Which evaluation metric measures cluster compactness and separation?
questions.explanation: The silhouette coefficient measures how compact points are within a cluster versus how separated they are from other clusters; support, confidence, and lift are association-rule metrics.
questions.hint: Silhouette coefficient đo đồng thời độ chặt trong cụm (compactness) và độ tách giữa các cụm (separation), giá trị càng gần 1 càng tốt. Quy tắc: đánh giá chất lượng clustering → Silhouette. Bẫy: support, confidence, lift là metric của association rules, không dùng để đánh giá cụm — đây là bẫy trộn khái niệm giữa hai chủ đề.
questions.trick: Thấy 'measures cluster compactness and separation' → chọn 'Silhouette coefficient'.

questions.question: A scatter plot shows points evenly spread with no visible trend. What can be inferred about correlation?
questions.explanation: No visible trend in a scatter plot indicates little or no linear relationship, so correlation is near zero.
questions.hint: Trong scatter plot, không có xu hướng rõ (điểm rải đều) nghĩa là không có quan hệ tuyến tính, nên correlation ≈ 0. Quy tắc: đám mây điểm tán loạn → r gần 0; đi lên → dương; đi xuống → âm. Bẫy: |r| gần 1 chỉ khi các điểm bám sát một đường thẳng; điểm phân tán đều thì không thể mạnh dương/âm.
questions.trick: Thấy 'evenly spread with no visible trend' → chọn 'Correlation is near zero'.

questions.question: What type of interactive visualization would you embed in a webpage to allow viewers to explore your prepared data?
questions.explanation: An interactive visualization embedded in a webpage lets viewers explore the data directly (filtering, zooming, hovering).
questions.hint: Nhúng lên webpage cho người xem tự khám phá (filter, zoom, hover) chính là Interactive visualization. Quy tắc: từ khóa 'embed + viewers explore' → chọn phương án này. Bẫy: Interactive storytelling là kể chuyện có dẫn dắt, Presentation visualization là trình chiếu tĩnh một chiều — không cho người xem chủ động tương tác như yêu cầu.
questions.trick: Thấy 'embed in a webpage to allow viewers to explore' → chọn 'Interactive visualization'.

questions.question: In 200 transactions, itemset {A,B} appears in 30 transactions. What is its support percentage?
questions.hint: Support của itemset = số transaction chứa cả {A,B}/tổng transaction, rồi nhân 100 để ra phần trăm. Ở đây 30/200 = 0.15 → 15%. Bước: đếm giao dịch chứa đủ cả A và B, chia tổng. Bẫy: đừng nhầm với số giao dịch chứa riêng A hay riêng B; support của itemset chỉ tính khi cả hai cùng xuất hiện.
questions.trick: Thấy '200 transactions, {A,B} in 30, support %' → 30/200 = 15% → chọn 15%.

questions.question: Which technique discovers relationships among items frequently appearing together?
questions.explanation: Association rule mining (frequent pattern mining) finds items that frequently co-occur in transactions.
questions.hint: 'Items frequently appearing together' là dấu hiệu kinh điển của Association rule mining (frequent pattern mining). Quy tắc: thấy 'co-occur/frequently together' → chọn phương án này. Bẫy: regression là dự đoán, feature hashing là mã hóa đặc trưng, data compression là nén — không phát hiện quan hệ đồng xuất hiện.
questions.trick: Thấy 'items frequently appearing together' → chọn 'Association rule mining'.

questions.question: If 400 out of 1000 records are used for validation and testing, how many remain for training?
questions.explanation: 1000 total minus 400 used for validation/testing leaves 600 records for training.
questions.hint: Số record training = tổng − (validation + testing). Ở đây 1000 − 400 = 600. Bước: cộng phần dành cho validation/testing rồi trừ khỏi tổng. Bẫy: đề đã gộp cả validation lẫn testing vào con số 400, nên chỉ cần trừ một lần; đừng trừ 400 hai lần.
questions.trick: Thấy '400 of 1000 for validation and testing, remain for training' → 1000-400 = 600 → chọn 600.

questions.question: If lift(A→B)=1, what does this imply?
questions.explanation: A lift value of exactly 1 means A and B occur together no more or less than expected by chance, so they are statistically independent.
questions.hint: Lift(A→B) = 1 nghĩa là A và B đồng xuất hiện đúng bằng kỳ vọng ngẫu nhiên, tức độc lập thống kê. Quy tắc: lift = 1 → độc lập; >1 → tương quan dương (hút nhau); <1 → tương quan âm (đẩy nhau). Bẫy: lift KHÔNG hàm ý nhân quả — 'A causes B' hay 'A always implies B' đều sai vì tương quan khác nhân quả.
questions.trick: Thấy 'lift(A→B)=1 implies' → chọn 'A and B are independent' (lift=1 độc lập).

questions.question: Which of the following algorithms belongs to the partition-based clustering category?
questions.explanation: K-Means is the classic partition-based (partitioning) clustering algorithm; DBSCAN is density-based and GMM/Mixture Models are model-based.
questions.hint: Partition-based clustering chia dữ liệu thành k phần rời rạc, tiêu biểu là K-Means. Quy tắc phân loại: K-Means = partitioning; DBSCAN = density-based; GMM/Mixture Model = model-based (probabilistic). Bẫy: GMM cũng chia dữ liệu nhưng dựa trên phân phối xác suất nên xếp vào model-based, không phải partition-based.
questions.trick: Thấy 'partition-based clustering category' → chọn 'K-Means'; DBSCAN density, GMM model-based.

questions.question: If 300 out of 500 records belong to class A, what percentage of the dataset is class A?
questions.hint: Tỉ lệ một class = số record của class/tổng số record × 100%. Ở đây 300/500 = 0.60 → 60%. Bước: chia rồi nhân 100. Bẫy: đây là bài class distribution đơn giản, chỉ cần đọc đúng tử số (số thuộc class A) và mẫu số (tổng dataset).
questions.trick: Thấy '300 out of 500 class A, percentage' → 300/500 = 60% → chọn 60%.

questions.question: Which step in the data mining pipeline involves collecting raw data from multiple sources?
questions.explanation: Data acquisition (data collection) is the stage where raw data is gathered from multiple sources.
questions.hint: Data acquisition (data collection) là bước đầu của pipeline: thu thập raw data từ nhiều nguồn. Quy tắc: 'collect raw data from multiple sources' → Data acquisition. Bẫy: model evaluation, pattern deployment, algorithm optimization đều là các bước sau (đánh giá/triển khai/tối ưu), không phải khâu thu thập dữ liệu ban đầu.
questions.trick: Thấy 'collecting raw data from multiple sources' → chọn 'Data acquisition'.

questions.question: Which characteristics indicate good clustering results? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Good clustering maximizes similarity within clusters (high intra-cluster similarity), keeps clusters distinct from each other (low inter-cluster similarity), and yields clear separation between clusters.
questions.hint: Kết quả clustering tốt: high intra-cluster similarity (giống nhau trong nhóm), low inter-cluster similarity (khác nhau giữa nhóm), clear separation (tách bạch rõ). Quy tắc: nhớ cụm từ 'high intra, low inter, clear separation'. Bẫy: random cluster assignment và high noise levels luôn là dấu hiệu xấu, không bao giờ nằm trong đáp án đúng.
questions.trick: Thấy 'good clustering results (Choose 3)' → chọn 'High intra', 'Low inter', 'Clear cluster separation'; bỏ random/noise.

questions.question: Which type of attribute has only two possible values, such as true/false?
questions.explanation: A binary attribute has exactly two possible values (e.g., true/false, 0/1).
questions.hint: Binary attribute chỉ có đúng hai giá trị (true/false, 0/1, yes/no); tiền tố 'bi-' nghĩa là hai. Quy tắc: 'chỉ hai giá trị' → Binary. Bẫy: continuous nhận vô số giá trị số, ordinal có thứ tự nhiều mức, temporal liên quan thời gian — đừng nhầm binary với các loại nhiều giá trị này.
questions.trick: Thấy 'only two possible values, such as true/false' → Bi = hai → chọn 'Binary attribute'.

questions.question: In a dataset of 400 transactions, itemset {A,B} occurs in 80 transactions. What is support?
questions.hint: Support của itemset = số transaction chứa cả {A,B}/tổng số transaction. Ở đây 80/400 = 0.20. Bước: đếm giao dịch có đủ A và B, chia tổng giao dịch. Bẫy: mẫu số là tổng số transaction (400), giữ kết quả ở dạng tỉ lệ [0,1] như đề yêu cầu.
questions.trick: Thấy '400 transactions, {A,B} in 80, support' → 80/400 = 0.20 → chọn 0.20.

questions.question: A scatter plot shows points forming an upward trend. What does this suggest?
questions.explanation: An upward trend (both variables increasing together) indicates a positive correlation.
questions.hint: Trong scatter plot, xu hướng đi lên (cả hai biến cùng tăng) thể hiện positive correlation. Quy tắc: dốc lên → dương; dốc xuống → âm; rải đều → gần 0. Bẫy: đừng nhầm 'upward' với negative; và 'constant value' ứng với đường ngang, không phải xu hướng đi lên.
questions.trick: Thấy 'points forming an upward trend' → chọn 'Positive correlation'.

questions.question: Which algorithms belong to density-based clustering? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: DBSCAN, OPTICS, and Mean Shift are density-based clustering algorithms; K-Means is partition-based and Decision Trees are a classification method.
questions.hint: Density-based clustering dựa trên mật độ điểm để tạo cụm và nhận diện noise: DBSCAN, OPTICS, Mean Shift. Quy tắc phân loại: K-Means là partition-based, Decision Trees là classification. Bẫy: đề yêu cầu chọn 3, đừng thêm K-Means vào (nó chia theo tâm cụm chứ không theo mật độ) hay Decision Trees (không phải clustering).
questions.trick: Thấy 'density-based clustering (Choose 3)' → chọn 'DBSCAN', 'OPTICS', 'Mean Shift'; bỏ K-Means/Decision Trees.

questions.question: If a dataset contains 500 transactions and an itemset appears in 50 transactions, what is its support?
questions.hint: Support = số transaction chứa itemset/tổng số transaction. Ở đây 50/500 = 0.10. Bước: chia tần suất xuất hiện cho tổng giao dịch. Bẫy: giữ kết quả dạng thập phân [0,1]; đừng nhầm mẫu số với con số nào khác ngoài tổng transaction.
questions.trick: Thấy '500 transactions, itemset in 50, support' → 50/500 = 0.10 → chọn 0.10.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of data visualization in data mining?
options: To present data patterns visually for easier interpretation
questions.explanation: Data visualization presents data and patterns graphically so they are easier to understand and interpret.
questions.hint: Mục đích chính của data visualization là trình bày dữ liệu và pattern một cách trực quan để dễ hiểu, dễ diễn giải. Quy tắc: chọn phương án nói về 'present/interpret visually'. Bẫy: lưu trữ dữ liệu là nhiệm vụ của database, mã hóa là bảo mật, và visualization hỗ trợ chứ không thay thế machine learning — cả ba đều sai.
questions.trick: Thấy 'main purpose of data visualization' → chọn 'To present data patterns visually for easier interpretation'.

questions.question: A dataset originally has 40 attributes. After preprocessing, 28 attributes remain. How many were removed?
questions.explanation: 40 - 28 = 12 attributes were removed.
questions.hint: Số attribute bị loại = số ban đầu − số còn lại. Ở đây 40 − 28 = 12. Bước: lấy hiệu hai con số, đọc kỹ đề hỏi 'removed' (bị bỏ) chứ không phải 'remain'. Bẫy: dễ chọn nhầm 28 hoặc tính lệch; luôn xác định rõ đâu là tử, đâu là hiệu.
questions.trick: Thấy '40 attributes → 28 remain, how many removed' → 40-28 = 12 → chọn 12.

questions.question: Which of the following algorithms is incompatible with approximate frequent pattern mining in streaming data?
questions.explanation: FP-growth is a batch, exact frequent-pattern algorithm requiring multiple passes over stored data; Space-saving, Sticky sampling, and Lossy counting are streaming approximate-counting algorithms.
questions.hint: Câu hỏi tìm thuật toán KHÔNG hợp với streaming approximate frequent pattern mining. FP-growth là batch/exact, cần lưu toàn bộ dữ liệu và quét nhiều lần nên không phù hợp luồng dữ liệu vô hạn. Quy tắc: Space-saving, Sticky sampling, Lossy counting đều là thuật toán đếm xấp xỉ cho stream (một lần quét, bộ nhớ giới hạn). Bẫy: đọc kỹ chữ 'incompatible' — chọn thuật toán batch, không chọn nhóm streaming.
questions.trick: Thấy 'incompatible with approximate frequent pattern mining in streaming' → chọn 'FP-growth' (batch/exact).

questions.question: A correlation heatmap shows r = −0.85 between two variables. What does this imply?
questions.explanation: r = −0.85 is close to −1, indicating a strong negative (inverse) linear relationship.
questions.hint: Hệ số r nằm trong [−1, 1]: gần ±1 là quan hệ tuyến tính mạnh, gần 0 là yếu. r = −0.85 gần −1 nên là quan hệ nghịch mạnh (strong negative): một biến tăng thì biến kia giảm. Quy tắc: xét |r| để đo độ mạnh, xét dấu để đo chiều. Bẫy: dấu âm không có nghĩa 'yếu' — độ mạnh phụ thuộc trị tuyệt đối, không phải dấu.
questions.trick: Thấy 'r = −0.85' → gần -1 → chọn 'Strong negative relationship'.

questions.question: A dataset contains 2000 samples, and 10% contain missing values removed during cleaning. How many samples remain?
questions.explanation: 10% of 2000 = 200 removed, leaving 2000 - 200 = 1800 samples.
questions.hint: Số mẫu còn lại = tổng − số bị bỏ; số bị bỏ = 10% × 2000 = 200, còn 1800. Bước: tính phần trăm bị loại trước rồi trừ khỏi tổng. Bẫy: đề cho 10% là phần BỊ LOẠI, đừng lấy luôn 10% làm số còn lại; kết quả phải là 90% của 2000.
questions.trick: Thấy '2000 samples, 10% missing removed, remain' → 2000-200 = 1800 → chọn 1800.

questions.question: Which chart is typically used to compare categories of data?
questions.explanation: A bar chart compares values across discrete categories; a histogram shows distribution of a continuous variable.
questions.hint: Bar chart so sánh giá trị giữa các category rời rạc (các cột tách rời). Quy tắc: 'compare categories' → Bar chart. Bẫy: histogram nhìn giống bar chart nhưng dùng cho phân phối một biến liên tục (các cột liền nhau theo khoảng bin); scatter plot và box plot phục vụ mục đích khác.
questions.trick: Thấy 'compare categories of data' → chọn 'Bar chart'; histogram là phân phối.

questions.question: If a cluster contains 50 points out of 200 dataset points, what percentage does it represent?
questions.hint: Tỉ lệ của cluster = số điểm trong cluster/tổng số điểm × 100%. Ở đây 50/200 = 0.25 → 25%. Bước: chia rồi nhân 100. Bẫy: mẫu số là tổng toàn bộ dataset (200), không phải số điểm ngoài cluster.
questions.trick: Thấy '50 points out of 200, percentage' → 50/200 = 25% → chọn 25%.

questions.question: Which visualization is useful for displaying the proportion of categories in a dataset?
questions.explanation: A pie chart shows the proportional share of each category relative to the whole.
questions.hint: Pie chart thể hiện tỉ lệ phần trăm của từng category so với tổng thể (mỗi miếng bánh = một phần trăm). Quy tắc: 'proportion/share của các category' → Pie chart. Bẫy: scatter plot cho quan hệ hai biến, histogram cho phân phối, heatmap cho ma trận giá trị — không loại nào thể hiện tỉ lệ phần của tổng tốt như pie chart.
questions.trick: Thấy 'proportion of categories in a dataset' → chọn 'Pie chart' (miếng bánh = tỉ lệ).

questions.question: Which tasks belong to pattern discovery in data mining? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Frequent pattern mining, sequential pattern mining, and association rule mining are pattern-discovery tasks; file compression and encryption are not data mining tasks.
questions.hint: Pattern discovery gồm các task khai phá mẫu: frequent pattern mining, sequential pattern mining, association rule mining. Quy tắc: các task có chữ 'mining' về pattern đều thuộc nhóm này. Bẫy: file compression (nén) và data encryption (mã hóa) là thao tác xử lý dữ liệu, không phải khai phá mẫu — loại chúng ra.
questions.trick: Thấy 'pattern discovery (Choose 3)' → chọn 3 câu có 'mining': Frequent, Sequential, Association rule; bỏ compression/encryption.

questions.question: Which clustering algorithm can detect clusters of arbitrary shape and identify noise?
questions.explanation: DBSCAN, a density-based method, finds arbitrarily shaped clusters and labels low-density points as noise/outliers.
